short: Atta — the engine for the Den: resolve, route, render
is: Atta, the host-agnostic engine for the Den: it resolves the tree, enforces its structural rules, asks the host about each node through one object-safe trait Atta defines, and renders files. Types and content are opaque to it; the host answers per type with an exhaustive match in application, never a runtime registry. It lives in this workspace as a crate only until it is split into its own library.
conventions: Never depends on another workspace crate and never names a Zurfur type — host-agnostic by construction, so it can be split out unchanged.
Used by application only; the API never imports it.
Its role is fixed: resolve, enforce structure, route changes, render. How it does that grows only as real needs appear, never ahead of them.
Nothing reads a node except through Atta; a payload is served only after its hash verifies, and until that check exists no payload is served at all.
Fails closed: one uniform not-found, no stored level means Private, and a mount whose target is not directly under a top-level directory is refused.

fs.name: src/fake.rs
fs.role: test-only Host over an in-memory tree that records every call

fs.name: src/host.rs
fs.role: the one Host trait (child, children, mounts, kind, admit; no payload method) and the values it speaks: Viewer, Lift, Found, Mount, Access, Reach, Admission

fs.name: src/lib.rs
fs.role: façade: the crate doc and the public surface

fs.name: src/list.rs
fs.role: Resolver::list: one page of an open directory; Private and refused entries drop before the sort and the cut; order by name, then segment, cards by a keyed hash

fs.name: src/metadata.rs
fs.role: Metadata, the closed per-node field set, and Type, the opaque type key

fs.name: src/name.rs
fs.role: NodeName: no Cc, no Cf but the two joiners, no /, not empty, at most 2048 bytes

fs.name: src/page.rs
fs.role: PageToken (a version and an offset, hex; FromStr and Display) and Listing

fs.name: src/path.rs
fs.role: RealPath, a node real path from the global root

fs.name: src/resolve.rs
fs.role: Resolver::resolve: a typed Den path from the viewer root, the level formula, standing along the real path, mounts and the mount guard, admit at each step, one NotFound; Caps

fs.name: src/segment.rs
fs.role: Segment, a node key: the ASCII allowlist, 1 to 2048 bytes, never . or ..

fs.name: tests/no_workspace_dependency.rs
fs.role: guard: atta depends on no workspace crate, of any kind (cargo metadata)

NodeName carries Unicode general category Cf as a hand table from the Unicode Character Database 16.0.0 (generated with Python unicodedata 16.0.0, 2026-10-10; checked unchanged against 17.0.0 and 18.0.0); std has no general-category query and no crate was added. Regenerate it when Unicode adds Cf code points.
